question: Where can I get a list of stand-alone battery storage (BESS) projects currently in permitting in Germany, with location, power (MW), developer, permitting stage and date?

answer.summary: No single German registry tracks BESS in permitting. Most stand-alone BESS are not BImSchG-listed and undergo confidential district Baugenehmigung (~400 authorities; >=4 MW within 200 m of substations privileged per § 35(1) Nr.12 BauGB since 23.12.2025) or municipal Bebauungsplan procedures. Closest official source is BNetzA's MaStR (753 planned >=1 MW units, 13.1 GW; 303 non-EEG/non-backup), but pre-grant filing is voluntary and only 65 hold post-grant permit data. Municipal consultations publish unstructured on UVP-Verbund and state DiPlanung/Bauleitplanung portals; EC JRC (WoodMac-backed) adds partial pipeline data.
main_caveats: Pre-permit MaStR registration is voluntary for non-BImSchG projects; 753 planned >=1 MW BESS in MaStR vs 18,158 grid requests (573.5 GW) and 1,937 commitments (54.2 GW) in 2025.

Pending Baugenehmigungen (~400 district Bauaufsichtsbehörden) are non-public administrative files; MaStR's Genehmigung schema requires a mandatory grant date (Datum), so pending applications cannot appear there.
No explicit stand-alone boolean exists in MaStR: 443/753 planned >=1 MW units link to an EEG facility (many PV+BESS), while 303 non-EEG/non-backup units serve as an imperfect stand-alone proxy.
276/753 planned >=1 MW MaStR battery units already carry overdue planned commissioning dates (< 2026-11-15), inflating the apparent active pipeline.
MaStR list JSON returns GenehmigungRegistrierungsdatum (upload date), not actual Genehmigungsdatum / DatumDerAntragstellung (which require scraping unit detail HTML or parsing the 3.2 GB XML dump).
answer.confidence_reason: Direct inspection of MaStR XSD/PDF schemas (rev 26.2), live API queries (753 records >=1 MW), MaStRV legal text (§§ 5, 15), BNetzA/SMARD reports, UVP portals, and state DiPlanung procedures confirms exact structural gaps.

attributes.note: MaStR provides municipality for 753/753 planned >=1 MW units, parcels for 539/753, and lat/lon in DE for 744/753 (9 masked). JRC adds coords.
MaStR reports Bruttoleistung & Nettonennleistung in kW (divide by 1000 for MW) plus NutzbareSpeicherkapazitaet in kWh. JRC reports MW & MWh.
MaStR exposes AnlagenbetreiberName (operator/SPV) for 698/753 legal entities >=1 MW.
attributes.gap_note: Natural-person owners are withheld per § 15(1) Nr.2 MaStRV (55/753 >=1 MW unshown); EC JRC publishes no developer column.

attributes.note: MaStR shows BetriebsStatus='In Planung' + linked SGE permits (65/753); JRC uses Announced (618), Permitted (8), Under construction (19).
attributes.gap_note: Pending Baugenehmigung and § 3(1)/§ 3(2) BauGB consultation milestones are not tracked in MaStR or JRC, only in municipal/UVP notices.

attributes.note: MaStR list API gives EinheitRegistrierungsdatum, GeplantesInbetriebsnahmeDatum, and GenehmigungRegistrierungsdatum (65/753).
attributes.gap_note: List API omits Datum and DatumDerAntragstellung (found on detail HTML/XML for 65 granted permits only); JRC omits all permitting dates.
